Cheese Bourekas

2 1/2 cups bread flour

1/2 teaspoon dried oregano

Preparation

Bake the bourekas for 20 minutes at 400 degrees. Remove from the oven and bake an additional 10-15 minutes or until golden brown. Turn on the broiler and broil the bourekas for 1-2 minutes.
